title.en: An Act Amending Republic Acts Numbered Nineteen Hundred, Twenty-Three Hundred One, Twenty-Seven Hundred One, and Thirty-One Hundred One, and for Other Purposes.
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Acts Numbered Nineteen Hundred, Twenty-Three Hundred One, Twenty-Seven Hundred One, and Thirty-One Hundred One, and for Other Purposes.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3640_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item (34), page 5, paragraph a, Title A, Section one of Republic, Act Numbered Nineteen hundred, is amended to read as follows:
"(34) Jose Rizal National Shrine, Calamba, Laguna P50,000.00"

Item (36), page 3, paragraph a, Title A, Section one of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred one, Item (ap), page 406, Group I, subparagraph 26, for the Province of Laguna, paragraph d, Section two of the same Act, are amended, to read as follows:
"(36) Jose Rizal National Shrine, Calamba, Laguna P10,000.00 "(ap) Jose Rizal National Shrine, Calamba, Improvement P5,000.00"

Item (cf), page 433, Group I, .subparagraph 26, for the Province of Laguna, paragraph c, Section two of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred one, is amended to read as follows:
"(cf) Jose Rizal Shrine, Calamba, Improvement _ P10,000.00"

Item 48, page 6, paragraph a, Title A, Section one of Republic Act Numbered Thirty-one hundred one, is amended to read as follows:
"48. Dr. Jose Rizial National Shrine, Calamba, Laguna P200,000.00"
The President of the Philippines is hereby authorized to determine and fix the site of the Jose Rizal National Shrine.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 22, 1963.
